{{Infobox auto}}
The '''cleaver''' is a knife-like sword with [[Slaughter]] I and Looting II, sold by the [[Cook|cook]]. Its internal name is "butcher knife". It deals {{Value|Cleaver|damage}} damage and has {{Value|Cleaver|durability}} durability, but it shortens the wielder's reach by 1 block.

== Obtaining ==
=== Trading ===
A level 4 cook sells it for one [[Obol|obol]].<ref name="trade">{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/butcher/4/butcher_knife.json}}</ref>

{{Sources}}

== Usage ==
Its attack reach is 1 block shorter than normal and it attacks at a speed of 1.6, as its tooltip says.<ref name="trade" /> It is repaired with iron ingots.
